about: The floors the evaluation runs alert on (decision 0126). Retrieval floors are per question set: handWritten is retrieval_questions.json, generated is generated/retrieval_questions.json; a null floor is measured and reported but never alerts. Answer floors compare answer-quality's judge and rubric means. Set on 2026-11-22 at the live numbers of 2026-11-21 minus 0.05; the lead raises them as the numbers improve.
